# AI-Based Underwater Visual Surveillance: Final Submission Validation Notebook

**Author:** Hemamdhar Dakarapu  
**Milestone:** Day 28 — Peer Mock Presentation & Final Submission  
**Package:** `underwater_surveillance` v1.0.0 (Production Release)  

This interactive notebook provides reproducible validation of all software package components, benchmark results tables, visual posters, peer review evaluation scorecards, and live inference outputs.

import sys
from pathlib import Path
import pandas as pd
import cv2
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from PIL import Image

# Add current directory to path
sys.path.insert(0, '.')

import underwater_surveillance
from underwater_surveillance import SurveillancePipeline, PipelineConfig

print(f'Imported underwater_surveillance package version: {underwater_surveillance.__version__}')
print(f'Package Author: {underwater_surveillance.__author__}')

cells.source: ## 2. Peer Mock Presentation Timing & Scorecard Poster

fig_path = Path('peer_mock_presentation_timing_and_rubric.png')
if fig_path.exists():
    img = Image.open(fig_path)
    plt.figure(figsize=(14, 6))
    plt.imshow(img)
    plt.axis('off')
    plt.title('Peer Mock Presentation Timing & Evaluation Scorecard', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
    plt.show()

arch_path = Path('final_comprehensive_architecture_and_results.png')
if arch_path.exists():
    img = Image.open(arch_path)
    plt.figure(figsize=(14, 7))
    plt.imshow(img)
    plt.axis('off')
    plt.title('Production System Architecture & Edge Profile', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
    plt.show()

road_path = Path('future_scope_technology_roadmap.png')
if road_path.exists():
    img = Image.open(road_path)
    plt.figure(figsize=(14, 6))
    plt.imshow(img)
    plt.axis('off')
    plt.title('3-Phase Autonomous Underwater Vision Roadmap', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
    plt.show()
## 5. Live Pipeline Inference on Sample Underwater Frame

config = PipelineConfig(
    enhancement_method='clahe',
    clip_limit=1.5,
    tile_grid_size=(8, 8),
    weights_path='../yolov8n.pt',
    imgsz=320,
    confidence_threshold=0.25,
    iou_threshold=0.50,
    tracking_max_age=5,
    device='cpu'
)
pipeline = SurveillancePipeline(config)

sample_img = Path('../day11_hemamdhar_visionpreprocessing/prepared_dataset_v1/val/DIATAquarium.v4i.yolov8/images/av0_0_20231228_102111_mp4-0_jpg.rf.7aa4fa3149688bd7abd114bfa46704b4.jpg')
if sample_img.exists():
    frame = cv2.imread(str(sample_img))
else:
    import numpy as np
    frame = np.full((640, 640, 3), (120, 80, 20), dtype=np.uint8)

result = pipeline.process_frame(frame)
print('Pipeline Result Latency Telemetry:')
print(result['latency'])
annotated = pipeline.draw_overlay(frame, result)
plt.figure(figsize=(8, 8))
plt.imshow(cv2.cvtColor(annotated, cv2.COLOR_BGR2RGB))
plt.axis('off')
plt.title(f'Live Sample Output (Latency: {result["latency"]["total_ms"]} ms | {result["latency"]["throughput_fps"]} FPS)', fontsize=12)
plt.show()
